question.value: Whether an infalling-rotating envelope with a centrifugal barrier, and associated chemical change, can be identified around IRAS 16293-2422 Source A using ALMA archival lines of OCS, CH3OH, HCOOCH3 and H2CS

evidence.quote: we have analyzed ALMA archival data of other molecular species to examine whether the centrifugal barrier of the infalling-rotating envelope can be identified in this source.
This paper makes use of the ALMA data set ADS/JAO.ALMA#2012.1.00712.S.
Spectral lines of OCS, CH$_3$OH, HCOOCH$_3$ and H$_2$CS were observed with the Band 6 receiver

frequencies_and_spectral_setup.value: Settings 230–250 GHz and 220–240 GHz; 122 kHz channels (0.15 km/s at 240 GHz), 468.750 MHz bandwidth

evidence.quote: The backend correlator was tuned to a resolution of 122 kHz, which corresponds to the velocity resolution of 0.15 km s$^{-1}$ at 240 GHz, and a bandwidth of 468.750 MHz.
42–44 antennas were used in the observations
the baseline length ranged from 17.14 to 636.53 m and from 19.58 to 628.65 m for the frequency settings in 230–250 GHz and 220–240 GHz, respectively
at a sub-arcsecond resolution ($\sim 0.6\ensuremath{''} \times 0.5\ensuremath{''}$)

The total on-source time were 51 minutes and 50 minutes for the 230–250 GHz and 220–240 GHz observations
carried out in the Cycle 1 operations on 22 May 2014 with the frequency setting in 230–250 GHz, on 14 June 2014 with the frequency setting in 220–240 GHz

findings_qualitative.value: OCS traces the infalling-rotating envelope; CH3OH and HCOOCH3 are compact near the centrifugal barrier; H2CS spans envelope to Keplerian disk

evidence.quote: OCS resides in the envelope, while CH$_3$OH and HCOOCH$_3$ have more compact distributions.

claims.hypothesis: OCS traces an infalling-rotating envelope with a centrifugal barrier around Source A
claims.experiment: Ballistic model compared with OCS PV diagrams along several position angles
claims.result: M=0.75 Msun, r_CB=50 AU, i=60 deg reproduce PV diagrams; Keplerian alone fails along outflow direction
claims.finding: An infalling-rotating envelope with centrifugal barrier exists in this hot corino

evidence.quote: The simple infalling-rotating envelope model successfully explains the OCS distribution

claims.hypothesis: Chemical composition changes around the centrifugal barrier
claims.experiment: Compared line distributions, temperatures and HCOOCH3/CH3OH ratios across components
claims.result: CH3OH and HCOOCH3 concentrated near CB; ratio rises from envelope to disk; temperature higher at CB
claims.finding: A drastic chemical change occurs around the centrifugal barrier

evidence.quote: A drastic chemical change is thus found to be occurring around the centrifugal barrier.

claims.hypothesis: H2CS traces a Keplerian disk inside the barrier
claims.experiment: Keplerian disk model for broad velocity components
claims.result: Model with 0.75 Msun, outer radius 50 AU explains broad components

evidence.quote: which strongly suggests the existence of the Keplerian disk structure within the centrifugal barrier.
